newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said. Trade light. Demand moderate. Seller interest moderate.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared with Thursday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs pt ld 110.00
